content:
The 2026 Paris-Chicago Conferences in the Philosophy of Logic and Mathematics will take place at the end of next week, at the Paris building of Chicago University. The topic is Formalization and Architecture of Mathematics

https://voices.uchicago.edu/phillogicmath/
Do you expect talks to be recorded or at least streamed?
No it won't neither be recorded nor streamed. But you're welcome to experience the gorgeous premises of the University of Chicago at Paris. (The amphitheater is beautiful.)
After some exchanges with the organisers, they tell me that they will propose speakers to be recorded and they will eventually post the links online on their website (and re-post here).
